title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — September 18, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B3.2 (Peaked September 17, 2026 at 12:16 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 421 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

The Sun's corona is much hotter than its surface, reaching temperatures of over 1 million °C. 🔥💫✨

A broad dark coronal-hole-like region is visible on the Sun’s southern-left side, while the rest of the imagery appears comparatively routine.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 335 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
